title: GARBAGE
text:
GARBAGE. UPDATE: DONT BUY. PEICE OF JUNK.
I thought this was nice, and it was for about 2 months. Now it won’t even open a can. It’s super hard to turn and it doesn’t cut. I never put it in the dishwasher, only hand washed it. It sucks. I really did like this one at first, but now it’s trash. Find yourself a better one. I’d recommend the one by Victorinox Swiss army. It’s pricy but in the long run, SO worth it.

Good little can opener. Love the magnet!
